title: FastVibe — Your desktop, ready for agent work
description: An open-source desktop workspace built on pi-coding-agent. Choose your models, extend your tools, and inspect the source from interface to agent engine.

hero.title: A workspace for your agents
hero.description: Powered by pi-coding-agent, with support for the Pi plugin ecosystem and a full desktop GUI for agent work.
hero.detail: Chat, tool calls, approvals and file review in one place. Open source from interface to engine, with tools and workflows you can extend.

overview.title:
Your workflow comes first.
Your tools should follow.
overview.description:
Pi provides a minimal, extensible agent core.
FastVibe brings that freedom to your desktop.

minimal.title: Minimal core. Room for your workflow.
minimal.copy: Pi starts with a lean system prompt and essential tools, leaving workflows to extensions. FastVibe adds planning, subagents and permission controls for a ready-to-use desktop experience.

models.title: Change models, not your workspace.
models.copy: Build on Pi’s multi-model foundation. Switch configured models within the same conversation, choosing a provider and reasoning level for the task instead of tying your workflow to one model.

extensible.title: Extend beyond the defaults.
extensible.copy: Add tools and workflows through skills and TypeScript extensions. FastVibe integrates Pi’s extension system and adds an MCP bridge, bringing your existing tools into the workspace.

overview.sourceCopy: FastVibe embeds the pi-coding-agent SDK directly. Follow the source from desktop interactions and session management to the agent loop and model adapters.
overview.scope: The application and agent-core layers above are MIT-licensed. Models and third-party services have their own terms.

features.title:
One workspace.
Every step in view.

workspace.title: Work with the full context
workspace.copy: Keep your conversation beside the files you're working on. Let your agent explore the project, make a plan and carry it through — while code previews and progress stay within reach.
workspace.alt: FastVibe in English: a Fieldnotes quick-search task, completed checklist and TypeScript file preview

review.title: See what changed, and why
review.copy: Tool calls and file changes are part of the conversation, not a separate trail to track down. Open a diff, review each edit and work with Git without leaving your task.
review.alt: FastVibe in English: reviewing the CommandMenu keyboard-navigation diff in the Git pane

models.title: Make the workspace your own
models.copy: Use the models you trust and the tools you already know. Configure providers, connect MCP servers and install skills and extensions. Your workflow doesn't have to fit a single provider.
models.alt: FastVibe in English: model and provider configuration

mobile.title: Take your agent with you
mobile.copy: FastVibe on your computer keeps the agent running. The mobile app lets you follow chats, send messages and handle approvals from anywhere.

items.chat: Follow conversations and tasks on the go
items.connect: Connect over Wi-Fi or scan a tunnel QR code
items.secure: Use FastVibe remote access and device authentication

mobile.cardCopy: Download the APK and connect it to FastVibe on your computer. Mobile releases are versioned independently from desktop builds.

download.title: A new workspace on your desktop
download.copy: Choose your platform, connect a model and start working.
download.fallback: Get the latest release on GitHub
download.setupNote: Free and open source. Your model provider may charge for usage.

openSource.title: Build your way of working
openSource.copy: FastVibe is open source under the MIT license. Explore the code, share an idea or help shape what comes next. A good workspace gets better with the people who use it.
